title: feat(cli): support scanning source from stdin
problem: The scanner can only read from the filesystem, so editor and shell pipelines cannot feed it source.
why: Stdin support enables quick ad-hoc checks and editor integrations.
scope: Add a documented way to scan a single source from stdin with a supplied logical filename.
guidance: Reuse the synthetic-project path; require an explicit filename for stable locations.
security: Bound the amount read from stdin to avoid unbounded memory use.

title: feat(report): add a schema version field to JSON output
problem: The JSON report has no explicit schema version, so consumers cannot detect breaking changes.
why: Consumers need a machine-checkable version to evolve safely.
scope: Add a `schema_version` field and document its semantics.
guidance: Keep it separate from the tool version.

title: test(report): assert a stable finding ordering contract
problem: The sort order is documented informally but not asserted as a contract.
why: Consumers and snapshot tests depend on a stable order.
scope: Add tests pinning the sort keys (file, line, column, rule id, fingerprint) with a mixed fixture.
guidance: Cover ties in file and line.
acceptance: Ordering contract tested in every format

title: feat(cli): support scanning multiple paths in one run
problem: Only a single positional path is accepted, so monorepos with scattered contracts require multiple runs.
why: Multi-path scans produce one report and one exit code for CI.
scope: Accept multiple paths and merge results deterministically.
guidance: Define how the scan root and relative paths behave with multiple roots.
tests: CLI test with two fixture directories
security: Reject paths escaping their roots as today.

title: feat(report): include the effective configuration in JSON output
problem: A JSON report does not record which configuration produced it, hurting reproducibility.
why: Recording effective settings makes CI results auditable.
scope: Add an `effective_config` object (excluding anything sensitive) to JSON output.
guidance: Reuse the serializable config; never include environment data.
acceptance: Tests cover disabled rules and overrides
security: Ensure no secrets or paths are included inadvertently.

title: feat(cli): add large-output handling and optional paging
problem: Very large terminal reports can overwhelm the console and slow piping.
why: Graceful handling keeps the CLI usable on large repositories.
scope: Stream or page terminal output when it exceeds a threshold, and document behavior when piped.
guidance: Never alter machine formats; terminal only.
tests: CLI test with a synthetic large report
security: Avoid buffering unbounded output in memory.
